// The R2 callback index used to be file-wide and keyed on the name alone, so a
// single local `callback := func(c *qt.C)` classified every `Run(..., callback)`
// in the file as a quicktest subtest. Both functions here declare `callback` and
// only one of them is a violation; a name-set index fails the second one and
// makes a repository-wide gate refuse correct code.
package fixture

import (
	"testing"

	qt "github.com/frankban/quicktest"
)

// stepper has nothing to do with quicktest. Its Run takes a callback of its own.
type stepper struct{}

func (stepper) Run(name string, step func(int)) {}

func TestCheckerCallback(t *testing.T) {
	c := qt.New(t)

	callback := func(c *qt.C) {
		c.Assert(1, qt.Equals, 1)
	}
	c.Run("a checker callback is the prohibited shape", callback)
}

func TestUnrelatedCallbackOfTheSameName(t *testing.T) {
	var steps stepper

	callback := func(int) {}
	steps.Run("an unrelated callback of the same name is not", callback)

	c := qt.New(t)
	c.Check(2, qt.Equals, 2)
}
